name: home-it
description: Home IT skills. Ships check-network: a repeatable playbook for home-network speed and DNS failures (compare system / router / public resolvers, inspect caches / upstreams / filters, measure throughput / bufferbloat / packet loss / Wi-Fi signal, localize the failing layer, inspect the router UI, and verify one fix at a time), plus drop-out and 4G/LTE branches and two read-only Bun scripts: a DNS series prober and a UPnP router-uptime reader). The same SKILL.md files back the Codex plugin.
